findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "nz_fuel_cost_calculator" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nz_tax_refund_calculator, find_calculator · Private data: nz_fbt_calculator, nz_paye_due_dates_calculator · Public sink: nz_parental_leave_calculator, nz_mortgage_calculator, nz_annual_leave_calculator, nz_electricity_cost_calculator, nz_vehicle_loan_calculator, depreciation_calculator · Destructive: nz_gst_calculator, nz_electricity_cost_calculator, nz_vehicle_loan_calculator, energy_expenditure_calculator, nz_fbt_calculator, nz_sick_leave_calculator, nz_paye_due_dates_calculator.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nz_tax_refund_calculator, find_calculator · Private data: nz_fbt_calculator, nz_paye_due_dates_calculator · Public sink: nz_parental_leave_calculator, nz_mortgage_calculator, nz_annual_leave_calculator, nz_electricity_cost_calculator, nz_vehicle_loan_calculator, depreciation_calculator · Destructive: nz_gst_calculator, nz_electricity_cost_calculator, nz_vehicle_loan_calculator, energy_expenditure_calculator, nz_fbt_calculator, nz_sick_leave_calculator, nz_paye_due_dates_calculator

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
